query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS positives,
                CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strength < 0 THEN -strength ELSE 0 END), 0) AS REAL)
                    AS negatives
           FROM observations
          WHERE generation_id = ? AND excluded_at IS NULL
